headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist - Technical and authoritative. Use font-black for top-level headers.

body.strategy: Terminal/Code UI - Strict, legible, monospace for all data, logs, code diffs, and general body text.

visual enhancers.surface_strategy: Retro-Futurism + Grid Borders. Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible. Use 1px borders (border-border). No soft shadows on data cards; use sharp 1px borders instead.
visual enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise/grain overlays to break pure black backgrounds. Use CSS repeating-linear-gradient for agent execution log scanlines.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating context menus: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border-white/10. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays.

component name.cards: Cardless approach. Rectangular, dense. border-collapse style with 1px border-r border-b.
component name.buttons: Sharp, 0px border-radius (rounded-none). High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
component name.badges: JetBrains Mono, text-xs, uppercase, solid background with high-contrast text matching severity.
component name.tables: Dense, monospace font for data, 1px bottom border per row. Hover effect: slight background tint.
component name.diff_viewer: Use distinct, readable red/green backgrounds for removed/added code lines with monospace font.

grids.base: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4.
grids.span_logic: Primary data/charts: col-span-2 row-span-2. Feeds/Lists: col-span-1 row-span-2. Summary metrics: col-span-1.

layouts.spacing: Dense but intentional. Use p-4 to p-6 for widgets. Generous spacing (p-12) only for empty states or overarching section padding.
layouts.alignment: Left-align all data, logs, code, and lists. Only center empty state illustrations.
layouts.structure: Sidebar navigation (collapsed to icons on small screens) + main content area. Sticky header for active PR context.

motion.micro_interactions: Minimalist. Instant feedback. Use border color transitions (transition-colors duration-150) rather than transforms.
motion.loaders: ASCII art loaders or blinking cursor (terminal style) for Agent state execution.
motion.data_flow: Use subtle horizontal scanning line animation for the Agent Graph Trace Timeline.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines. Critical vulnerabilities must be clearly visible against #050505.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative terminal scanlines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='run-pipeline-btn').

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards and developer tools. Thin or Regular weight.
media.images: Limited use. Only for user avatars or abstract background textures for empty states.

3d libraries.strategy: Not recommended for dense security data unless visualizing a complex dependency graph.
3d libraries.graph_viz: If a 3D dependency/RAG graph is needed, use React Force Graph 3D with a transparent background. Otherwise, stick to 2D custom SVGs or HTML/Tailwind for the LangGraph state machine visualization.

abstract_code_texture.description: Dark neon digital number projection, use as subtle background for empty states or login area.

developer_avatar_1.description: 3D Cartoon character avatar for user profile.

developer_avatar_2.description: 3D Cartoon character avatar with blue hat.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a dense, highly technical security dashboard. Avoid generic 'SaaS' looks. Embrace a terminal/retro-futuristic vibe with stark contrast.
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects. Rely heavily on customized Shadcn primitives (.js).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Always use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl.
For the Agent Graph Trace Timeline, construct a clean, left-to-right or top-to-bottom pipeline view. Use stark borders and neon accent colors to show state (Running=Blue, Failed=Red, Success=Green).
Use Phosphor icons. Install via `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, and status badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px sharp borders instead of shadows in this context.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles, in this case sharp edge (rounded-none) buttons with high contrast interactions.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and terminal-style loaders separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (use .jsx/.js versions for this project).
